label: post_outcome_diagnostic_not_alpha_validation

primaryResult.interpretation: V1.3 produced no High-priority selections in this crisis window. This was not automatically a failure: the frozen Research set as a group did not beat CSI300 at the pre-registered 60d horizon.

researchDiagnostics.label: correct_block_theme_absorption_and_execution
researchDiagnostics.interpretation: The structural 5G direction was real, but visible bullish forecasts, prior theme rerating and execution risk were sufficient reasons not to promote. A direct company bridge did not guarantee base-horizon alpha.

researchDiagnostics.label: mixed_expressions_direction_not_sufficient
researchDiagnostics.interpretation: The physical server/cloud thesis was strong, but the two acceptable expressions diverged sharply. One expression beat the benchmark while the preferred expression materially lagged, so opportunity-first evaluation does not support calling the basket a success. This does not repeat the 2020Q2 construction/PV false-negative pattern.

researchDiagnostics.label: correct_block_and_repeated_expression_bias
researchDiagnostics.interpretation: High valuation and lack of realized 2020 earnings confirmation correctly blocked Primary. More importantly, the pure-gold preferred expression again lagged a diversified Zijin control, repeating the 2020Q2 gold expression failure.

horizonDiscipline: The memory-theme basket beat CSI300 at 60d but underperformed it by about 23.20pp at 120d, consistent with a time-bounded cycle rather than a durable company engine.
The auto basket was very poor at 60d, while 长城汽车 later surged by 120d. This validates requiring a new recovery signal/re-underwriting rather than buying at the March demand-collapse cutoff.

rationale: The frozen discovery hypothesis centered on server DRAM because that was the strongest physical server-memory evidence.

Contemporaneous pre-cutoff evidence also described a broader storage upcycle: NAND Flash prices had risen, NOR Flash was tight/starting to rise, DRAM had stopped falling, and A-share names such as 兆易创新/北京君正 were discussed as storage-cycle/domestic-substitution beneficiaries.
兆易创新's March 26 investor communication explicitly described its Flash products as NOR Flash and SLC NAND and discussed shortage-driven semiconductor cycles.
Therefore the correct process lesson is to split distinct product-market cycles into independent hypotheses instead of forcing every storage expression through a server-DRAM revenue bridge.
missedOpportunityDiagnosis.nonConclusion: This same-period outcome does not prove that 兆易创新 or 北京君正 should have been selected ex ante. It identifies a hypothesis-definition/retrieval gap to test in another window.

notRepeated: 2020Q2 showed large Research false negatives in construction machinery and LONGi; 2020Q1 does not support mechanically loosening timing/absorption gates. 5G, the server basket, and gold all failed to beat CSI300 at the 60d hypothesis level.
repeated: Pure thematic exposure can be a poor preferred expression when expectation burden is high. 山东黄金 lagged benchmark and/or 紫金矿业 at the 60d base horizon in both 2020Q1 and 2020Q2.
A direction can be economically correct while the chosen expression set is inadequate; opportunity-first does not excuse a selected expression that itself fails benchmark-relative adequacy.
newCandidateFailureClasses: hypothesis granularity collapse: distinct product subcycles are merged into one narrow causal hypothesis, causing valid adjacent opportunities to be discarded by an overly specific mapping gate
direct-exposure bias: purity of thematic exposure is over-weighted relative to valuation/expectation burden and diversified earnings support

decision.reason: The cross-window evidence now identifies two plausible general failure classes, but historical replay remains model/search contaminated. The next untouched window should pre-register diagnostics for product-market decomposition and directness-versus-expectation tradeoffs before any rule is promoted.
decision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.3 on an untouched 2019Q4 window. Explicitly preserve separate product-market hypotheses when the frozen evidence supports them, and record whether a diversified expression with lower expectation burden is acceptable without requiring it to be the best peer. Use the result to decide whether V1.4 should formalize a hypothesis-decomposition gate and an expression-burden override.

prohibitedUses: Do not promote all Research selections because one server expression worked.
Do not loosen price/expectation timing gates from the 2020Q2 result; 2020Q1 supplies strong counterexamples.
Do not treat the 60d memory miss as proof that generic semiconductor theme buying is valid.
Do not prefer pure thematic exposure merely because its causal mapping is cleaner if expectation burden makes the expression inadequate.
Do not tune V1.3 from this same historical window or claim clean alpha validation.
